note: Coverage may not fall below `metrics` minus `tolerance`. Raise them when coverage improves; never lower them to make a red build green — that is the regression this gate exists to catch. `measured` is what the run that seeded this actually reported; `metrics` is that minus environmentMargin, which exists only because the seeding run and the enforcing run may be different machines. Once CI has confirmed its own numbers, re-pin there with no margin so the ratchet sits tight against reality.
